text: {"lessons":["I added to Stock B at progressively higher prices, then made no trades as my account fell; I should set clear reasons and limits for adding or holding rather than reacting—or failing to react—to recent prices.","My account value dropped from 105,847.45 in Period 6 to 93,672.35 in Period 10, so I should plan for sustained downturns and keep my stock exposure compatible with my apartment goal and time horizon.","A few months of gains or losses do not show whether my approach is working; I should review my overall allocation and progress toward my goal over longer periods, not chase short-term performance."]}
